desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 and with reference to our earlier intimation dated 21st August, 2026, regarding approval for incorporation of Craftsman Fronberg Precision GmbH, Germany, we wish to inform you that Craftsman Fronberg Precision GmbH has been incorporated in Germany on 27th August, 2026 as a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Craftsman Germany GmbH, a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
